evidence.title: Zuse changelog
evidence.finding: v0.26.1 adds Stable/Preview update tracks, first-run setup, standalone zuse command and PR follow-up on failing checks; Slack cloud tasks are Unreleased and opt-in.

evidence.title: Implementation and acceptance status
evidence.finding: Per-capability status values source, compiled, pending or verified; provider protocols, harness, plugins, archive, Slack and cloud are mostly source/compiled with live acceptance pending.

evidence.title: Native harness capabilities
evidence.finding: Zuse native Rust harness: bounded parallel reads, nested agents depth 2, durable messages between agents, shared request budget; external coding CLIs do not run on this kernel.

evidence.title: Chat permissions
evidence.finding: Ask for approval, Approve for me and Full access per adapter; approvals require explicit Yes; saved approval rules on the host; plan mode separate; provider sandboxes are not a uniform OS sandbox.

evidence.title: Custom ACP agents
evidence.finding: Custom ACP agents added in Settings with executable and arguments; no shell expansion; Zuse does not install them.

evidence.title: Model connections
evidence.finding: Model accounts for the Zuse harness: ChatGPT OAuth (PKCE) and SuperGrok device authorization, AES-256-GCM local store, hosted storage option; CLI logins remain independent.

evidence.title: Hosted plugins and agent workspaces
evidence.finding: Hosted plugin API with Personal and organization workspaces; local stdio MCP servers run lazily with a cleared environment.

evidence.title: Persistent Zots and application control
evidence.locator: Authority and storage; Delivery and supervision
evidence.finding: Zots are persistent coordinators with purpose, instructions, decisions, digest and reports that delegate to worker conversations with concurrency limits, durable events and a Rust supervisor.

evidence.title: Paired remote access
evidence.finding: Noise NNpsk0 encrypted pairing with 10-minute invitations, up to 32 persistent devices, revocable grants, full control of the profile.

evidence.title: Account-managed access
evidence.finding: Account-linked host access with environment listing, device revocation and a managed host link; remaining acceptance pending.

evidence.title: Pull requests

evidence.finding: Native PR board and browser PR tab with diff, comments, reviewers, create PR, draft/ready/close; PR watch with bounded automatic CI/review follow-up.

evidence.finding: Shared Git panel with stage, commit, fetch, push, pull, branches and Open PR; mutations are never auto-retried.

evidence.title: Thread archive storage
evidence.finding: Archiving checkpoints a managed worktree to a private ref, removes the checkout and restores it before reactivation.

evidence.title: Slack app

evidence.title: PostHog product analytics
